# Quaternius Sci-Fi Gun Pack — review-only source

This folder preserves the untouched Blender donor files selected for KYX.IO
weapon exploration. It is source material only: nothing in this directory is
copied into `public/` or the production package.

- Creator: Quaternius
- Official pack page: https://quaternius.com/packs/scifigun.html
- Official source folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1jaszGQ7QN2KIWFFoOVYy8y8qFe27yVL2
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal / public-domain dedication
- Acquired: 2026-07-31T03:28:33.578Z
- Intended use: donor/reference source for separately reviewed KYX.IO weapon
  adaptations

`SOURCE_INVENTORY.json` records the exact Google Drive file IDs, byte counts,
and SHA-256 hashes. `SOURCE_LICENSE.txt` is a normalized snapshot of the
license document distributed with the pack. Credit is not required by CC0,
but KYX.IO should retain “Sci-Fi Gun Pack by Quaternius” in project credits.

The Rifle donor is the initial VLR-7 exploration source. A donor download is
not runtime integration or visual acceptance; adapted exports must remain
review-only until their own provenance, structural validation, player-eye
capture, and human verdict are complete.
